content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result: INDEMN — missing (fallback cure proposed).**

- Section 7 is titled "Indemnification of Contractor" but contains no indemnity at all: 7(a) is a fee-based liability cap, 7(b) a consequential-damages waiver, 7(c) an attorneys'-fees waiver. A document-wide search for "indemn" hits only the heading; no hold-harmless or defence language exists anywhere.
- Section 5(c) provides a bare non-infringement warranty for the Works, with no defence obligation, indemnity or remedy, and any claim would be squeezed by the 7(a) cap (whose only carve-out mis-references "Paragraph 9", the Independent Contractor clause).
- Because no Vendor IP indemnity exists at all (walk-away territory), we inserted the shortest fallback clause as new Section 7(d): Contractor IP indemnity for the Services and Works, the customary Company modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure–modify–replace and refund remedies, and a 3× annual fees super-cap expressly overriding the 7(a) cap so the super-cap governs.
- We deliberately did not add a Customer indemnity (none exists to narrow) and stayed at fallback rather than volunteering preferred-level scope that would require introducing a Clear Capital indemnity.
